text: 事关资本市场，金融监管部门将开会；韩国10月半导体出口增超450%……周末重磅消息来了！ 金融监管部门明日将召开两个座谈会，会议在央行举行；沪深上市公司净利润超5万亿元，创四年新高……
text_en: Capital market in focus as financial regulators to meet; South Korea's October semiconductor exports up over 450%... Major weekend news is here! Financial regulators to hold two symposiums tomorrow, with meetings at the PBOC; net profit of Shanghai and Shenzhen listed companies exceeds 5 trillion yuan, a four-year high...
